name: frontend-design
tagline_zh: 新UI总像模板？改版后还是“大众脸”？这个技能教你定调、选字、做取舍，让界面一眼有性格，告别默认感。
tagline_en: Tired of generic UI? This skill helps you set tone, pick type, and make deliberate choices—so your interface has.
desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
why_zh: 它不教组件，而是逼你回答“为什么这样设计”，从审美方向到字体细节，专治“说不出理由”的默认设计。
why_en: It doesn't teach components—it forces you to justify every choice, from aesthetic direction to type details, killing default.
